macro.fx_impact: Observed: BNM USD/MYR reference 4.0858 on October 6. For an MYR-based investor, USD appreciation would raise MYR translated investment value and depreciation would lower it, all else equal. This is a scenario, not an FX forecast; company-level currency effects depend on revenue, costs and hedging.
